key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to find good solutions for expensive industrial simulators using far fewer high-fidelity runs.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to optimize process flowsheets and other costly engineering models when simulations are slow, variables are many, and budgets are limited.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to identify and keep the most influential design variables.
Fit a fidelity-aware Gaussian process that learns relationships between cheap surrogate-like evaluations and expensive simulations.
Guide sampling with a cost-aware acquisition rule plus cooldown/promotion logic to balance exploration across fidelities.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—a plasmid DNA bioprocess in SuperPro Designer and a green fuel synthesis plant in Aspen HYSYS—and it reduced high-fidelity evaluations while maintaining competitive performance.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the sensitivity reduction and fidelity correlation; if either is weak, the method may miss important variables or misallocate expensive evaluations.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
